## Foods & dishes
- [[RecipeDB2]]: ≈840 recipes (region "Eastern European" 2,503); not released.
- [[Food.com Recipes and Interactions]]: 381 tagged `russian`.
- Dish inventories: [[WorldCuisines]] 76 dishes (30 Russia-only; coulibiac, kurnik, Borodinsky bread, Tatar dishes such as uchpuchmak); [[FmLAMA]] 57 dishes (872 rows; Olivier salad, Guriev porridge); [[World Wide Dishes]] 9 (4 Russia-only; pelmeni, borscht). Ingredient lists only.

## Ingredients & food composition
- No national food composition table for this country is in the vault or `Backlog/`; use [[USDA FoodData Central]] (and [[FooDB]] / [[Phenol-Explorer]] for compounds) by name matching.
- Plants: [[CMAUP]] 360 plants on the map.

## Compounds & traditional medicine
- [[Exposome-Explorer]]: 87 concentration rows (Shelekhov Study).
- [[Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases|Duke]] ETHNOBOT 11 records (plus 95 region-only "USSR" rows); [[KNApSAcK Family]] World lists the country (edible/medicinal species records; counts for European countries were not scraped).
- Global backbone via [[Global]]: [[FooDB]], [[Phenol-Explorer]], [[CTD]], [[SpiceRx]], [[DDID]] for food–drug interactions.

## Gaps
- No Russian FCT and no Russian-language recipe corpus or BLEnD file.
- Russian folk herbal medicine has no structured dataset.
